title: Include imagePullSecrets[].name in Secret reference extraction
context: Real production Helm chart validation revealed a gap in field-path enumeration: registry pull secrets (spec.template.spec.imagePullSecrets[].name) are a common, legitimate Secret reference that the original design never covered. Six review rounds focusing on parsing correctness missed this completeness gap. Touches invariant(s): con_039cee7367 (Memory hygiene is the agent's job, done without waiting for the human: accept shipped roadmap proposals, settle provenance-repair escalations (apply the true commit or drop), re-anchor or stale findings, and land the resulting capture commits through a PR. Only decisions that need genuine product judgment are queued for the human.).
decision: Added POD_SPEC_REF_SUFFIXES table and integrated imagePullSecrets[].name → Secret into the field-spec generator so literal and directly-templated pull secret names are extracted as reference candidates.
consequences: Extractor now correctly identifies registry pull secret name references in Deployment/StatefulSet specs
Scanner behavior changes on manifests with direct imagePullSecrets declarations; indirected charts remain unaffected
Field-path enumeration moves closer to real-world Helm authoring patterns beyond what unit tests expose
alternatives_rejected: Attempting programmatic inference of all Secret references (fragile and incomplete)
Deferring until the next review cycle discovered it independently
Adding isolated fixes without categorizing pod-spec-level references as a distinct class
